nodes.label: Top Navbar (sobre / skills / projetos)
nodes.rationale: Minimal monospace anchor navigation to the three main page sections.

nodes.label: Dark Grid Background with Monospace/Gold Accent Theme
nodes.norm_label: dark grid background with monospace/gold accent theme
nodes.rationale: Near-black background with subtle grid lines, scanline-dimmed photos, monospace type and gold accents create a developer/terminal aesthetic.

nodes.label: Project Card Component
nodes.rationale: Each card pairs a numbered (01-04) cover photo with title, one-line description, chevron arrow and up to 3 tech tag chips plus a '+N' overflow counter, keeping cards uniform in height while signalling more stack detail on the detail page.

nodes.label: Numbered Section Header '03 — PROJETOS'
nodes.rationale: Gold index number, thin rule and monospace uppercase title give a consistent, code-like wayfinding pattern across portfolio sections.

nodes.label: Tech Tag Chip with Overflow Counter
nodes.norm_label: tech tag chip with overflow counter

nodes.label: 'Visualizar' Hover Tooltip
nodes.rationale: Hover state on a card reveals a 'Visualizar' label to make the card's clickability (navigation to project detail) explicit.

nodes.label: Dark Terminal-Style Visual Design
nodes.rationale: Near-black background with subtle grid, monospace typography, amber accent color, code-comment section headers ('// OVERVIEW') and bracketed indices ('[01]') give a developer/terminal aesthetic consistent with a programmer portfolio.

nodes.label: TaskFlow Overview Section
nodes.rationale: Explains the project as a first full stack effort uniting a Spring Boot back-end with a React front-end, aiming at a real, working product.

nodes.label: Atividade Acadêmica
nodes.rationale: The activity's requirements dictate the portfolio's 4-section structure.

nodes.label: Portfólio Pessoal
nodes.rationale: Built as an academic activity to present the author's trajectory, technical stack and projects as a Software Engineering student; structure follows the activity's requirements (4 main sections).

nodes.norm_label: secure authentication with jwt and refresh token

nodes.norm_label: full task crud with filters and sorting

nodes.norm_label: responsive interface with react + tailwind css

nodes.label: Badge 'Disponível para Projetos'
nodes.rationale: Green status dot communicates availability for work to recruiters/clients.

nodes.label: Bio Paragraph
nodes.rationale: 19-year-old Software Engineering student at CEUMA via the Oxygeni hub in São Luís (MA); passionate about end-to-end software, from database to interface; gamer in free time.

nodes.label: Dark Grid + Gold Accent Visual Theme
nodes.norm_label: dark grid + gold accent visual theme
nodes.rationale: Near-black background with subtle grid, monospace typography and gold/yellow glow accents for a terminal/retro-gaming developer aesthetic.

nodes.label: Headline 'DAVI DUARTE'
nodes.rationale: Large monospace name with surname in glowing gold accent as the primary visual anchor.

nodes.label: Info Cards Grid (Loc / Faculdade / Foco / Hobby)
nodes.norm_label: info cards grid (loc / faculdade / foco / hobby)
nodes.rationale: 2x2 grid of labelled key-value tiles for scannable personal facts.

nodes.label: Logo <davi.dev />
nodes.rationale: JSX self-closing tag style wordmark signals a developer identity.

nodes.label: Photo 'Player Card' (PLAYER_01, 19 anos)
nodes.rationale: Gold-framed photo styled as a game character card (PLAYER_01, age tag, Oxygeni Hub caption) tying the gamer hobby into the personal brand.

nodes.label: 'Visualizar' Button Overlay
nodes.rationale: Likely a Figma/prototype viewer artifact rather than part of the design; uncertain.

nodes.label: Loading (Em aprendizado)
nodes.rationale: Faixa 'LOADING: ->' sinaliza tecnologias que o autor esta estudando, mostrando roadmap de evolucao (containers, cloud, SSR e arquitetura distribuida) sem declara-las como dominadas.

nodes.label: Estetica dark estilo terminal
nodes.rationale: Fundo escuro com grid sutil, tipografia monoespacada, numeracao '02 ---' e destaques amarelos; comunica identidade de desenvolvedor e mantem consistencia visual entre as secoes numeradas.

nodes.label: Stack Técnica por Categoria
nodes.rationale: Skills organized by category: linguagens, frontend, backend, banco de dados, ferramentas.

nodes.label: 2x2 Project Card Grid
nodes.rationale: Dark terminal/monospace aesthetic with a faint background grid; each card pairs a dimmed cover photo, numbered badge (03, 04), title, one-line Portuguese description, tech tags and a chevron affordance leading to the project detail page.

nodes.label: Tech Tag Chips with +N Overflow
nodes.rationale: Shows only the first three technologies as yellow-outlined chips and collapses the rest into a '+N' counter to keep cards compact and uniform in height.

nodes.label: Dark Terminal-Style Design Language
nodes.rationale: Near-black grid background, monospace headings, amber/gold accent tags and '// SECTION' code-comment labels give a developer/terminal aesthetic consistent across portfolio detail pages.

nodes.label: Local Persistence with LocalStorage
nodes.rationale: Client-only persistence avoids needing a backend for a personal catalog.

nodes.label: GameTracker Overview (Origin Story)
nodes.rationale: Born from the author's hobby of playing videogames: tired of forgetting which games were finished or wanted, so built a personal solution. Consumes RAWG API (largest games database) for info, covers and ratings; users add games to custom lists (playing, finished, abandoned, wishlist).

nodes.norm_label: search and filters by genre and platform

nodes.label: Learning: global state with Context API
nodes.norm_label: learning: global state with context api
nodes.rationale: Project described as important to consolidate knowledge of global state, form handling and Vercel deploy.

nodes.label: Linktree-style link page for developers
nodes.rationale: Born from a practical need: centralize social networks and projects in a single link.

nodes.norm_label: support for multiple social networks with icons
